string.text: Each action has two binds: stack (every item in the cell or opened stack popup) and item (only the hovered row). Hold and move to paint. Inventory sort will not chain into whatever slides under the cursor.
Hold to transfer every item in the stacked cell under the cursor (loot and trade). In the stack popup, transfers the rest of that opened stack. Replaces GAMMA Fast Transfer. Default Left Shift.
Hold to transfer only the hovered item. In the stack popup, each hovered row transfers that item.

Hold to disassemble every item in the stacked cell. In the stack popup, does the rest of that opened stack. Equipped items and items that cannot be disassembled are skipped. Only while inventory or loot is open.
Hold to disassemble only the hovered item. In the stack popup, each hovered row is one item.
Grant unread stash coords when disassembling PDAs. Double tool wear if a coord is found, triple if the PDA was encrypted. Shows a lock icon on encrypted PDAs.
When GAMMA wants a tool type, wear the lowest-condition stack of that type that will still survive (including drag-and-drop). Does not change which tool type is required.
Scrap detached scopes, silencers, launchers, and tac kits into craft parts.
After disassemble, post the parts you get on the PDA ticker. Off by default.
Hold to drop every item in the stacked cell. In the stack popup, drops the rest of that opened stack. Equipped and quest items are skipped. Only while inventory or loot is open.
Hold to drop only the hovered item. In the stack popup, each hovered row is one item.
Hold to strip every weapon in the stacked cell. In the stack popup, strips the rest of that opened stack. Non-weapons are skipped. Stripped parts stay with the weapon.
Hold to strip only the hovered weapon. In the stack popup, each hovered row is one weapon.
If you disassemble a weapon that still has attachments or parts (keybind, drag a tool, or context menu), strip those first instead. Once nothing is left to strip, disassemble works normally.
